data.long_meaning: Nit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nit' meaning 'Intellect', 'Thought', or 'Wisdom'. In Hindu mythology, Nit is a name of Lord Shiva, the God of Destruction and Transformation. The name is a symbol of knowledge, understanding, and self-realization. The name Nit carries the meaning “Intellect, Thought, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nit usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, thought, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
